Wholesale Ice Buckets, LED Ice Buckets and Wine Tasting Spittoons

1 L to 12 L ice buckets, double-wall coolers, LED-lit buckets, spittoon buckets, ice tongs and bottle racks.

Request ice buckets & coolers pricing Custom logo options

About this range

This range covers everything that holds, chills or clears away: tabletop 1 L buckets, classic 4 L and 8 L champagne buckets, a 12 L double-wall cooler for bottle service, and a boat-shaped 5 L bucket built for seafood and grazing displays. The LED versions add rechargeable illumination for bottle service and evening terrace service, and the wine tasting spittoon buckets give tasting rooms a hygienic, purpose-built solution for guided flights.

Material focus

PS, PP, PET, PS with LED module

Ice Buckets &amp; Coolers — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Ice Buckets & Coolers range include?

This range holds 16 items, specified in PS (with LED module), PP and PET. Orders come most often from hotels and resorts, bars and nightclubs and wineries and tasting rooms. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

What ice buckets & coolers options are available for wholesale?

This range covers the shapes, capacities and case packs listed on the product cards. Each SKU page states its exact specification and customization route.

Browse the catalogue

What is the MOQ for a ice buckets & coolers model?

MOQ is maintained by SKU/model, not by the category. A standard bulk order, logo decoration and a custom gift-box build can have different minimums for the same model. Check the selected product page or send the SKU, quantity and requirements for a model-specific quotation.

How MOQ works

Can ice buckets & coolers be ordered in our own colour?

Colour is assessed per SKU and per material. Provide the Pantone reference or a physical sample so we can confirm feasibility and issue a colour chip or pre-production sample for approval before the production run.

Custom branding

Which logo methods can be used on ice buckets & coolers?

The suitable method depends on the surface, artwork, decoration area, colour count, expected durability and order quantity. Send the artwork with the selected SKU and we confirm what is feasible for that model.

Logo decoration guide

What should I check before ordering ice buckets & coolers for export?

Confirm the item dimensions, unit weight, case pack, carton size, packaging protection, destination and delivery date. These inputs determine the freight configuration and the quotation basis.

Import duty guide

Can I order a sample first?

Sample availability and cost are confirmed for the selected SKU and customization route. Include the SKU, artwork, packaging requirement and destination when requesting a sample.

Request a sample
